decision: Evaluate all fixed ablations; do not promote v2 as universally better. Development improves hard evidence recall but still 4/5 false positives; strict rarity loses one original paraphrase, relaxed rarity admits 5/5 hard negatives. No tuning on held-out results.
qualification: Independent fixture authoring before candidate runs; small synthetic test, no model answer probability or production safety claim. V1 frozen inputs/code remain unchanged.
